examples.title: Underline
examples.description: The existing default: an underline follows the selected tab. Arrow keys move and activate tabs immediately.

examples.title: Pill / segmented
examples.description: Set variant="pill" on TabsList to use a light outlined rail and a white selected pill. The cursor glides on a gentle spring; the Radix selection API stays the same.

examples.title: Full width
examples.description: Use fullWidth on either list variant to distribute tabs evenly across the available width.

examples.title: With icons and counts
examples.description: Compose decorative icons and TabsCount inside a trigger. Keep icons aria-hidden and use a readable count label.

examples.title: Controlled selection
examples.description: Own the selected value with value and onValueChange. External actions and keyboard selection stay in sync.

examples.title: Manual activation
examples.description: Set activationMode="manual" when loading a panel is expensive. Arrow keys move focus; Enter or Space activates the focused tab.

examples.title: Vertical tabs
examples.description: Set orientation="vertical" on Tabs. Up and Down move through tabs, and content transitions follow the vertical axis.

examples.title: Disabled tabs
examples.description: Disabled triggers remain visible, do not activate, and are skipped by arrow-key navigation.

examples.title: Right to left
examples.description: dir="rtl" reverses horizontal keyboard navigation and panel motion. The measured cursor follows the actual tab positions.

examples.title: Keep panel state
examples.description: Opt in to forceMount on TabsContent to preserve local state. Hide inactive forced panels explicitly with data-[state=inactive]:hidden.
